checks.item: 1a. Fake-payment-notice filter: the auditors' three bypasses (brand in the sender or account name, lure in the recipient note, lure put in by a correction) and the 30 day cut-off
checks.evidence: Ran the auditors' own script again as tests/out/verify2-abuse/a1-rerun.ts. A (documented lure) 422. B (user 'PayPal Billing', account 'PayPal') 422, nobody emailed. C (lure in the note) 422. D (clean send, then PUT with lure subject, message and a new address) 422, victim got nothing. H (free account 31 days old) 422. New angles in p1-filter.ts: lure in a template sent by bulk is refused whole (422, no batch written, nobody emailed); a public form named as the lure answers the visitor 503 with the neutral sentence and leaves no draft; create-and-send, quick correct and reassign all go through the same guard. Both refusals say why and give the contact form address.

checks.item: 1b. The filter must read everything a recipient will read, on every path that emails them
checks.evidence: tests/out/verify2-abuse/p1-filter.ts cases 5, 6, 7, 8 (results in p1-filter.json). Four ways deliver the complete lure from a new free account.
checks.still_broken: (1) Rename after sending. Sign up as 'Jo Plain'. Create an envelope in order: signer 1 is your own address, signer 2 the victim; subject 'Invoice #4471', message 'Amount $499.00 was charged. To cancel call +1 (888) 555-0142 now.' (no brand, so send is 200). PATCH /me {name:'PayPal Billing'} 200, PATCH /account {name:'PayPal'} 200. Sign as signer 1. Result: the victim is emailed, heading 'PayPal Billing sent you a document to sign: Invoice #4471', brand line 'PayPal', From header '"PayPal Billing via Sign&Grow"', phone number in the body. advance() never asks the guard. (2) Words on the page. Send a clean envelope, then PUT a correction that adds a note field with value 'PayPal: Your payment of $499.00 was charged. To cancel call +1 (888) 555-0142 now.' Result 200, and the victim gets 'Updated: ...' whose 'What changed:' line quotes the whole note. Field wording is not read by fakeNotice. (3) Recipient name. Two viewers at one address, the first named 'PayPal: payment of $499 charged, call +1 (888) 555-0142'. Send is 200 and the email heading is 'For PayPal: payment of $499 charged, call +1 (888) 555-0142: ... sent you a document to view'. (4) Void reason. Subject 'PayPal invoice #4471 - payment of $499.00 charged' (no phone, send 200). POST /void {reason:'To cancel this charge call +1 (888) 555-0142 now.'} is 200: the email is 'Voided: PayPal invoice #4471 - payment of $499.00 charged' with the phone number in the body. voidEnvelope reads the reason alone.
checks.suggested_fix: Ask the guard wherever an email to a recipient is written, not only where the sender clicks: in notifyRecipient/advance (hold the email, tell the sender why). Add to what fakeNotice reads: senderText() of every field, recipient names when they are printed (shared address, in-person), and for a void the subject together with the reason. Refuse a brand name at PATCH /me, PATCH /account and sign-up for accounts that have not paid, so the name can never change under an envelope that is out.

checks.item: 1c. Normalisation: look-alike letters, spaces and punctuation inside brand names, 'however it is spelled'
checks.evidence: p1-filter.ts cases 1 to 4. Spaced, dotted, Cyrillic s and capital-I spellings are caught (422). The following all returned 200 and the victim got the email with brand, money and phone number.
checks.still_broken: Each on a new free account, message 'Your payment of $499.00 was charged. To cancel call +1 (888) 555-0142 now.' unless said. Glued words: user name 'PayPalBilling' 200; account name 'PayPalSupport' 200; subject 'PayPalInvoice #4471' 200; 'MyPayPal invoice #4471' 200 (the pattern wants no letter before or after the brand). Money word: 'Your PayPal invoices' + 'Two invoices are overdue. Call ...' 200 (plural is not matched); 'You were billed $499.00' 200; 'purchase' and 'receipt' 200; 'PayPal inv0ice #4471' 200; 'A charge of $499.00' 200. Phone: '888–555–0142' (en dash, what a word processor types) 200; U+2010 hyphen 200; '888/555/0142' 200; bullets 200; '888 555 O142' 200; '555-0142' 200; underscores 200. Look-alikes: 'PɑyPɑl' (Latin alpha) 200; 'PayPaӏ' (palochka) 200; 'Mıcrosoft' (dotless i) 200; 'Rnicrosoft' 200; 'Micrօsoft' (Armenian o) 200; small capitals 200.
checks.suggested_fix: For brands that are not everyday words (PayPal, Microsoft, McAfee as a company word, Coinbase, Venmo, Geek Squad, Best Buy) match anywhere after removing everything that is not a letter or digit. Money: match stems (invoic, bill, charg, pay, refund, receipt, purchas, renew, subscri, transact, debit) or any currency amount, after the same look-alike folding. Phone: fold every dash, dot, slash, bullet and underscore to one separator, read O as 0 between digits, and count digits (7 or more in a short window). Fold letters with the Unicode confusables table instead of a hand list.

checks.item: 1d. The filter must not refuse honest senders (a new mistake in the fix)
checks.evidence: p1-filter.ts case 9 and p10-existing.ts. Control 'Subscription agreement / Any questions, ring 555 123 4567' is 200.
checks.still_broken: New free account named 'Sarah McAfee', subject 'Lease agreement', message 'Please sign the lease.': send 422 'The name "Sarah McAfee" reads like McAfee ... Use your own name'. McAfee is a common surname and is not on the EVERYDAY list. 'Invoice for the boiler repair. Questions? Call 231-135-5550.': 422, because the digits 2 3 1 1 3 match the look-alike pattern for 'Zelle' ([z2][e3][l1|][l1|][e3]). 'Payment due on completion: $2,311.30. Our office: 020 7946 0991.': 422, same reason. 'Lease renewal' + 'Renewal for the flat at 12 Apple Street. Call me on 555 123 4567 with questions.': 422. 'Subscription agreement' + 'The Microsoft Word original is attached. Any questions, ring 555 123 4567.': 422.
checks.suggested_fix: A brand match must contain at least 3 letters of the brand (never digits alone). Treat McAfee like Norton (refuse only when nothing but company words stands beside it). In the lure check, count an everyday brand word (Apple, Amazon, Norton, Zelle) only when it stands beside a company word, and do not count 'Microsoft Word/Excel/Teams/365 document' style product mentions. Say in the refusal which words triggered it.

checks.item: 1 left open: accounts on the paid plan are not checked at all
checks.evidence: tests/out/verify2-abuse/p2g-paid.ts. This is the definition the fixer was given, but it costs a scammer nothing: see new bug 'Pay 9 dollars, send the lure to hundreds, take the 9 dollars back'.
checks.still_broken: New account, minutes old. Documented lure before paying: 422. Subscribe ($9), then 12 envelopes of 50 viewers each with subject 'PayPal invoice #4471' and the phone message: all 200, 600 people emailed, 0 signatures used. POST /billing/refund: 200 {refunded:'$9.00', signatures:9, plan_ended:true}.
checks.suggested_fix: See the new bug.

checks.item: 2a. Daily limit counts every person newly emailed (first send, editor correction, quick correct, reassign, bulk, public forms) and unpaid accounts keep a limit after the first week; the refusal says the number, when it resets and how to lift it
checks.evidence: a1-rerun.ts E: 50 sent, 51st 429, three rounds of address changes all 429, 50 distinct addresses mailed. G (8 days old, paying on): stops at 200 with the text naming the Plan page and the contact form. p2-limit.ts: quick correct to a new person at the limit 429 with number, 'in about 24 hours' and how to lift; quick correct back to someone already reached today 200; void and delete of the big envelope gives nothing back (still 429, reached 50); sender sends to self and passes on from the signing screen: 403 three times with neutral words, nobody mailed; bulk of 50 rows plus a fixed copy recipient refused whole (429, 0 batches written), 49 plus the copy 200, one more 429. p9-misc.ts C: three create-and-send calls of 30 viewers at the same moment: 200,429,429, 30 reached, no draft left. Help, security and the Plan page (settings/page.tsx line 558, billing limits) now state both numbers. Left open and acceptable only with a note: writing again to someone already reached is unlimited (60 envelopes to one address in a minute all went, p2-limit.ts E).

checks.item: 2b. Operators: 'Trust this account' / 'Remove trust', and plan, created date and trusted state next to each report and request
checks.evidence: p2-limit.ts F: a plain user calling POST /operator/accounts/:id gets 404; operator {trusted:true} 200, then the send that was 429 is 200 and the documented lure is 200; {trusted:false} 200 and the next new person is 429 again; admins are emailed both times. Queue rows carry account_name, account_plan, account_created_at, account_trusted_at (p4-reports.ts A). Looked at /app/operator at 390x844 and 1280x900: 'Account Paula's workspace · free plan · created Nov 20, 2026 · not trusted · paused' under each request and report, 'Trust this account' in all three lists. Two small faults are listed under new bugs (empty body lifts a pause; the 'Remove trust' email states the wrong number in the first week).

checks.item: 3a. A paused account emails nobody new by any path (one guard)
checks.evidence: The direct paths hold. a1-rerun.ts F: new send 403, PUT with a changed and an added person 403, quick correct 403, reminder 403, nobody mailed. p3-pause.ts B through an API key: create-and-send, quick correct, remind, extend, PUT add person all 403 with the stored reason. Bulk and bulk remind go through the same calls. Timer (p3 G): no reminder and no 'expires soon' to recipients while paused, the sender still hears; both go out after the pause is lifted. Signer, download, name-only fix and export still work.
checks.still_broken: (1) p3-pause.ts A. Before the pause: envelope in order, signer 1 is the sender's own address, then two viewers who have not been emailed yet. Pause the account. The sender signs their own part: 200, and both viewers are emailed for the first time ('Your account statement'). The fixer left this open; it is a way to queue victims before a pause and release them after it. (2) p3-pause.ts C. Paused account (plan grove, so no filter): PUT a correction that adds a note field with lure wording, no person changed: 200, and the person who has the document gets 'Updated: Agreement' quoting the lure. POST /void with reason 'PayPal refund department: call +1 (888) 555-0142 about your payment.': 200, emailed to everyone on it. (3) p3-pause.ts E. Paused account sends 120 team invitations to 120 addresses, all 200 (see new bug). (4) Turning a copy recipient into a signer while paused (same address) sends them a new signing request (p3 D). That one is arguably within the brief.
checks.suggested_fix: In advance(): when the account is paused (or the guard refuses for another reason) do not email a person who has never been emailed on this envelope; leave them pending, write an audit line, tell the sender, and run advance() for the account's open envelopes when the pause is lifted. While paused, send no 'Updated' emails and read the void reason with the filter for every account, or send the void notice without the sender's free text.

checks.item: 3b. The refusal gives the real reason the account was paused
checks.evidence: p3-pause.ts B: with suspended_reason 'A card dispute on your last payment.' every 403 reads 'Sending is paused on this account. Reason: A card dispute on your last payment. Until a person has looked at it ...'. Pause by reports stores '3 different recipients reported documents from this account' (p4-reports.ts A). Browser, phone and desktop: the red banner and the toast after 'Send reminder' on a paused account both show 'Reason: Three recipients said they never heard of you.' A signer passing on gets neutral words without the sender's business.

checks.item: 3c. Public form on a paused or unconfirmed account: neutral words for the visitor, nothing left behind
checks.evidence: p3-pause.ts F: GET says closed:true, POST start 503 with exactly 'This form cannot take new signatures right now. Please contact whoever gave you the link.', nothing in the answer about a review or report, no envelope and no recipient row for the visitor, and a visitor who started before the pause can still finish (200). p9-misc.ts B: same for an owner who never confirmed their address. Current code also closes the form while the account is closing. Looked at /f/<slug> for a paused owner at 390x844 and 1280x900: the closed card is shown before any field.

checks.item: 4. Reports an operator confirmed as abuse keep counting towards the automatic pause
checks.evidence: a7-rerun.ts (the auditors' script): two reports marked 'This was abuse', third report: pausedNow true. p4-reports.ts A: one upheld report from the signing screen plus two by security code pauses at the third different reporter; the same person reporting twice (by code and from the screen) counts once; a dismissed report does not count (B); reports older than 30 days do not count (E); after an operator lifts the pause the next two reports do not pause and the third does. The operator page says 'Reports you mark as abuse keep counting towards that. Reports you dismiss do not.' A hole next to this item is listed as a new bug: one stranger can produce three 'different recipients' through a public form.

checks.item: 5a. GET /support/mine: only requests filed while signed in, or from an address the user has confirmed
checks.evidence: p5-support.ts A, the auditors' steps: logged-out request from victim@example.com, attacker signs up with that address and does not confirm: /support/mine returns []. Same through an API key of the unconfirmed account (0). A second sign-up as ' Victim@Example.COM ' is 409. The attacker's own request written while signed in is the only one they see. A confirmed attacker with their own address sees nothing of others (B). PATCH /me cannot change the address. One limit is listed under new bugs: confirming only proves that someone clicked the link in the mailbox.

checks.item: 5b. The contact form does not mail a stranger's words to a typed address
checks.evidence: p5-support.ts C: POST /public/support with email target@example.org, name 'PayPal Billing: call +1 (888) 555-0142' and a lure message. The acknowledgement holds only the reference, 'Reply to this email if you want to add anything' and 'If you did not write to us, someone typed your address into our help form by mistake'; neither the name nor the message is in the HTML or the plain text. A signed-in confirmed sender typing someone else's address gets no copy sent there (B). Confirmed sender, own address (also in other capitals): copy included. Signed in but unconfirmed: no copy. The sender of a named envelope is told once a day without the stranger's words (E). Left open and acceptable with a note: the fixed acknowledgement can still be sent to any address, 8 an hour per caller and with no cap per target (39 arrived in one inbox from 31 callers). A cap per typed address per day would close it.

checks.item: 6a. Access codes: only wrong tries count, a stranger cannot lock the signer out for good, frozen after 10, at least 4 characters everywhere
checks.evidence: p6-codes.ts. A: five wrong tries from one address give 401 then 429 'Wait 15 minutes' for that address only; the right code from another address opens the document; 100 right tries leave the count unchanged. B: ten wrong tries from three addresses: the tenth answers 423, code_frozen_at set, the right code is then 423 with 'frozen ... has been told and can set a new code', a signer who was already in stays in, the sender gets 'Access code frozen' (always) and 'Ask the sender' works twice a day. A new code by quick correct or by PUT unfreezes and resets the count; the old code is then wrong. C: 20 wrong tries at the same moment from 20 addresses: exactly 10 counted, 9 x 401 and 11 x 423, one freeze email. D: codes of 1, 3, '  ab  ' and the number 123 are refused (400 with the sentence) on create-and-send, send of a draft, PUT correction, quick correct, bulk (row error) and public form (503 neutral, owner told). E: a locked link shows only brand, envelope head and recipient; doc, save, complete, download, reassign, decline, name, ask all 401; a forged cookie stays locked. Screens at 390x844 and 1280x900: wrong code message, frozen screen with 'Ask the sender', the answer 'Done. We asked Nora Sender.', the envelope page and the Correct dialog both say the code is frozen. Left open notes are acceptable: a draft may hold a short code (refused at send), an old short code stays until changed, the per-address count is in memory. One small fault is under new bugs (saving the same code on a frozen code is answered ok).

checks.item: 6b. Signing limit per link and address, with a generous ceiling per address
checks.evidence: p6-codes.ts F: one link opened 640 times from one address: the first refusal is call 601. A colleague at the same address with another link: 200. The same link from another address: 200. Ceiling 20,000 per address per 10 minutes in find().

checks.item: 7a. A public form never hands a visitor someone else's unfinished document
checks.evidence: p7-forms.ts A, the auditors' P1 again: Vera starts, consents and saves a private answer. A stranger in another browser types 'Not Vera' with VERA@example.com: fresh document, not her link. The stranger types her exact name and address: fresh document, does not see her answer, consent not given. A forged cookie with her envelope id and a wrong seal: fresh document. Vera in the same browser: resumed with the same link (also with other capitals). B: a cookie from one form does not resume on another form of the same owner; after finishing, the same browser gets a fresh document; a second person in the same browser at the same address gets their own. Cookie is 'HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=86400'.

checks.item: 7b. Unfinished starts are cleared after a quiet day and one address may have at most 3 per form, so a stranger cannot tie up the owner through a form
checks.evidence: What works: p7-forms.ts D: a start left alone for 25 hours is set to expired by cronTick with the audit line 'Started from a public form and left unfinished for 24 hours', the same browser then starts afresh; since commit 192f0d2 typing counts as activity (a start saved a minute ago is not cleared and can be finished). C: fourth and fifth start from one address 429 with a clear message, another address and another form are not affected, room again after one finishes, nothing kept of the refused visitor. Forms marked 'shared device' allow 30 and clear after 60 minutes. Since the last payment change a form start holds no signature (balance stays 3/0/3).
checks.still_broken: tests/out/verify2-abuse/p7b-forms-billing.ts with paying switched on. A: new account with 3 signatures and one form. One stranger at one address starts the form three times with made-up emails and leaves. A real visitor from another address then gets 503 'This form cannot take new signatures right now. Please try again a little later ...' and keeps getting it until the timer clears the starts a day later. The owner's balance is still 3 available, yet the owner is emailed 'Your form "Gym waiver" has run out of signatures ... your balance is empty ... Top up or start the monthly plan and the form works again at once.' C: a form marked shared device on an account with 20 signatures: 20 starts from one address in an hour (the per address rate limit) shut it for everyone for an hour. With TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=0 the cap of 3 is skipped altogether and only the 20 an hour limit remains.
checks.suggested_fix: Do not count other people's unfinished starts against a new visitor at start time (nothing is held any more); check the balance when the visitor presses Finish and tell them politely if it is empty. If the count is kept, count only starts whose visitor has consented or typed something, cap it per address across the whole count, and make the owner email say the truth ('N people have started and not finished; your balance is M').

checks.item: 8. 'Report this email' in every signing email, and reporting by security code on /check without opening the link
checks.evidence: mail.ts adds the line to the HTML box and the plain text of every email that carries a code (new, reminder, updated, reopened, expiring, resent, again, completed); the link is /check?code=XXXX-XXXX-XXXX&report=1 (p4-reports.ts A). POST /public/check/report: 200 with the code typed in lower case with spaces; the recipient stays 'sent' with viewed_at null (the document is not opened or marked); one audit line 'Reported as suspicious'; the abuse inbox gets it; it counts towards the pause exactly like a report from the signing screen. The code of an email whose link was replaced reports under the address that email went to (C). Unknown, empty and missing code: 404 with a sentence; 10 an hour per address, shared with the signing-screen report (B). Browser at 390x844 and 1280x900: the link opens the check page with the code looked up and the report form open ('What is wrong?', optional text, 'Send report'); after sending: 'Thank you. Your report is in. ...'; an unknown code shows 'We do not recognise this code' with 'Tell us about this email'. No horizontal scroll, no page errors. Left open (no acknowledgement email to the reporter) is fine: the page confirms it. A hole next to this item is under new bugs: once the sender voids and deletes the envelope, its emails can no longer be reported by code.

new_bugs.title: Team invitations carry any text to any address: no filter, no daily limit, no pause, no confirmed address needed
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-account.ts POST /account/invites
new_bugs.detail: Steps (tests/out/verify2-abuse/p9-misc.ts A and p3-pause.ts E): sign up as 'PayPal Billing' and never confirm the address. PATCH /account {name:'PayPal: payment of $499.00 charged. Not you? Call +1 (888) 555-0142'} is 200. POST /account/invites {email} 60 times to 60 addresses: all 200. Each person gets an email from Sign&Grow with subject 'PayPal Billing invited you to PayPal: payment of $499.00 charged. Not you? Call +1 (888) 555-0142 on Sign&Grow' and heading 'Join PayPal: payment of $499.00 charged. ...'. The same account is refused when it tries to send an envelope (403, address not confirmed). A paused account sent 120 in a row the same way. Fix: require a confirmed address, refuse while paused, run the brand and lure check over the user and account name, count invited addresses in the `reached` table against the same daily limit, and add a small limit of open invitations per account.

new_bugs.title: One stranger can pause any sender who has a public form: three made-up addresses, three reports
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts reportAbuse(); src/server/routes-envelopes.ts POST /public/powerforms/:slug/start
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p4-reports.ts D, run again on the current tree): an honest account has a public form. A stranger at one address, no account: POST start with name 'Nobody 1' and nobody1@made-up.example, take the signing link from the answer, POST /sign/<token>/report {reason:'phishing'}. Repeat with two more made-up addresses. After the third report the owner's account is paused with reason '3 different recipients reported documents from this account': the owner's own send is 403, the form answers real guests 503. After an operator lifts the pause the stranger does it again with three new addresses and it is paused again. The three unfinished starts allowed per address are exactly the three reporters needed. Fix: a report from a visitor of a public form (envelopes.powerform_id set and the reporter is form_recipient_id) goes to the operator queue but does not count towards the automatic pause, or counts only once the address is proven (the visitor opened the link from the email). Also count reporters per device address.

new_bugs.title: Pay 9 dollars, send the documented lure to hundreds of people, take the 9 dollars back
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts hasNotPaid() and emailRefusal(); refund rule in src/server/routes-billing.ts
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p2g-paid.ts): new account. The documented lure is refused (422). Start the monthly plan ($9). In the next minutes send 12 envelopes of 50 viewers each with subject 'PayPal invoice #4471' and 'Your payment of $499.00 was charged. To cancel call +1 (888) 555-0142 now.': all 200, 600 people emailed, because a paid account skips the filter and both daily limits. Viewers use no signature, so all 9 signatures are unused: POST /billing/refund answers 200 {refunded:'$9.00', signatures:9, plan_ended:true}. Net cost nothing. The same works with a stolen card until the dispute arrives. Fix: keep the fake-notice and brand-name check for every account that a person has not marked trusted, whatever it paid; give paid accounts a higher daily limit in their first 30 days instead of none; and let a full refund of the only payment count the people reached since then against the unpaid limit (or hold the refund for review when more than the unpaid limit was reached).

new_bugs.title: A stranger can use up an unpaid owner's daily limit through their public form
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-envelopes.ts POST /public/powerforms/:slug/start; overDailyLimit() in src/server/envelopes.ts
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p2-limit.ts C): a free account in its first week (50 a day) has a public form. One stranger at one address starts the form with fake0@nowhere.example, declines from the signing link, and repeats: 20 starts in an hour are all 200 (declining frees the cap of 3), the owner's count of people reached goes to 20 and the owner gets 20 'Declined' emails. With a few more addresses the count reaches 50. Then the owner's own send to a real customer is 429 'This account has sent to 50 in the last 24 hours' and a real guest on the form gets 503. Fix: count form visitors in their own allowance per form (and say so on the PowerForms page), not in the owner's limit for people the owner chose; or count a form visitor only when they finish.

new_bugs.title: Three walked-away starts shut a new owner's public form for a day, and the owner is told the balance is empty when it is not
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-envelopes.ts POST /public/powerforms/:slug/start (available - startedForms < 1)
new_bugs.detail: Steps and result are in check 7b (p7b-forms-billing.ts A). The email to the owner says 'your balance is empty' and 'Top up or start the monthly plan and the form works again at once' while GET /billing shows balance 3, held 0, available 3. Paying for one signature would not reopen it either while three ghost starts are counted. Fix as in check 7b.

new_bugs.title: A public form plus the owner's own sends use more signatures than the account has
new_bugs.where: src/server/credits.ts reserved() leaves form starts out; sendEnvelope() checks available() only
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p7b-forms-billing.ts B, paying on, new account with 3 signatures): three guests start the form (200, 200, 200; nothing held). The owner sends three envelopes to three clients: all 200, balance 3, held 3, available 0. The three guests sign: 200 each, balance 0, held 3, available -3. The three clients sign: 200 each. Final: balance -3, six signatures used with three owned. The comment in routes-envelopes.ts says 'a form can never collect more signatures than its owner has'. Fix: at Finish on a form, check available() and tell the visitor politely when it is 0 (and email the owner), or let sendEnvelope subtract unfinished form starts the way the form start does.

new_bugs.title: Voiding and deleting an envelope makes its emails unreportable and hides earlier reports from the operator
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-trust.ts POST /public/check/report and GET /operator/queue (JOIN envelopes)
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p9-misc.ts D and E): send an envelope, void it, DELETE it. The recipient who still has the email clicks 'Report this email': 404 'the document it was about has been deleted since ... we cannot file a report against it here', and no report is stored, so it never counts towards a pause. Second case: two recipients report two envelopes; the sender voids and deletes both; a third recipient reports a third envelope. The account is paused (3 reporters, good) but GET /operator/queue shows 1 report instead of 3, because the query joins envelopes. A sender can send, void and delete at once and never be paused by reports. Fix: keep the account id with each forgotten code so a report by code still counts against the account (with reporter unknown), and LEFT JOIN envelopes in the queue so reports on deleted envelopes stay visible with account, reporter and reason.

new_bugs.title: Confirming an address proves a click, not who holds the password
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-account.ts POST /auth/verify; relied on by GET /support/mine and the inbox
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p5-support.ts A, last lines): the attacker signs up with victim@example.com and sets a password. The victim gets 'Confirm your email for Sign&Grow'. If the victim opens the link (POST /auth/verify with the token, no session needed), the attacker's login is confirmed: GET /support/mine in the attacker's session then returns the victim's earlier request as well (2 instead of 1), and the same login passes every other 'confirmed address' check. It needs the victim's click, so medium. Fix: the confirmation page says 'Someone created a Sign&Grow login with this address. If that was not you, press Not me' (which deletes the login), and a confirmation made from a browser that is not signed in to that login asks for its password or sends a set-password link.

new_bugs.title: Saving the same code on a frozen access code answers ok and changes nothing
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts correctRecipient(); src/components/sender/dialogs.tsx
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p6-codes.ts B): code 4242 is frozen after 10 wrong tries. The sender calls POST /envelopes/:id/correct {recipient_id, access_code:'4242'}: 200 {ok:true}; in the app the toast is 'Updated. Their link still works.' The code is still frozen and the signer still gets 423. The dialog does show a warning to type a different code, the API says nothing. Fix: answer 400 'This code is frozen. Choose a different one.' when the code is frozen and unchanged.

new_bugs.title: POST /operator/accounts/:id with an empty body lifts a pause

checks.item: 1a. Every signer sees the sender's field wording (read-only values, notes, values a signer may still change) from the first look, in the Document view and the Text view
checks.evidence: tests/out/verify2-integrity/p1-seen.ts A, B, F and ui3-screens.cjs. Re-ran the auditor's a8: Ada's GET /sign/:token now lists Ben's read-only sentence (from 'sender'), his changeable start value (from 'start'), a read-only dropdown value and a ticked read-only box with its label. Also true when Ben is second in an ordered envelope and still waiting (B). When Ben saves a private draft over the start value, Ada still gets the sender's words, and Ada's own download before completion prints the sender's words and not Ben's draft (F). In the browser at 1280x900 and 390x844 both views show all four pieces with who wrote them ('Written by Demo Sender, in the part for Ben Partner', 'Filled in by Demo Sender for Ben Partner, who can still change it'), no sideways scroll. Left open by the fixer and acceptable before launch: envelopes already out before the prefill column show a changeable start value only once its owner finishes; empty fields of others are not drawn; the sender's own 'document so far' download prints unfinished signers' drafts.

checks.item: 1b. Nothing the sender wrote is printed on the final PDF that a signer was never shown
checks.evidence: p1-seen.ts C. The fix covers field values only. A recipient's name (and address) is also sender-written text, and it is printed through a full_name or email field. For a person who has not finished, GET /sign/:token shows nothing for such a field (fieldDisplayValue returns '' until completed).
checks.still_broken: Ordered envelope: Ada (1), Ben (2), copy recipient (3) named 'Ada also owes a fee of 5000 dollars', with a full_name field for the copy recipient on page 1. PUT 200, send 200. Ada's and Ben's signing data never contain the sentence (C_ada_sees_name_before_signing false, C_ben_sees_name_before_signing false). Both sign, the copy goes out, the envelope completes, and the document pages of the final PDF carry 'Ada also owes a fee of 5000 dollars' (C_final_pdf_pages_have_sentence true). No accomplice is needed: a copy recipient finishes by itself.
checks.suggested_fix: In GET /sign/:token show full_name and email fields of every other recipient from the first look with the name and address the sender typed (from 'sender' until that person finishes), and do the same in the viewer copy in pdf.ts. Treat a recipient's name and address as sender wording wherever that recipient has a full_name or email field (senderText, printedView, seenView, askView).

checks.item: 2a. A correction that touches signed content is refused with 409 unless it carries "resign": true, and the sign-again flow does what was asked
checks.evidence: p2-lock.ts A and C, p9-credits.ts, ui3-screens.cjs. Re-ran the auditor's a4: read-only sentence for Ben after Ada signed is 409, code 'sign_again', with the sentence quoted and 'Nothing was saved'. Also 409: moving Ada's signature, a note, ticking Ben's empty box, the date format, swapping the file, adding a document, an empty new field for Ben, resign given as the string 'true' or as 1. Allowed without it: renaming Ben, renaming a document, the subject. With resign true: Ada goes back to 'sent' on the same link, gets 'Changed after you finished: ...' quoting what changed, her signature marks are cleared and her typed answer kept, a Finish without a signature image is refused, earlier_signatures keeps the first signature and answers, the audit trail has 'Envelope corrected', 'Asked to sign again' (first time, address, answers, SHA-256 of the signature image) and 'Signed again', the hash chain is intact, and the certificate prints 'First completed' and 'Completed again'. Same result on an envelope from a public form, on a bulk row through an API key, and for an in-person signer. Another account gets 404. Deleting the envelope removes the earlier_signatures rows. Left open and acceptable: the lock is envelope-wide (stated in the README), consent is not asked again, no visual comparison.

checks.item: 2b. Once someone has finished, nothing printed on the pages they signed changes without their being asked again
checks.evidence: p2-lock.ts B and p1-seen.ts D, E. Two routes still change a signed page with a plain 200 and no question to the signer.
checks.still_broken: Route 1 (p2-lock.ts B): the sender ticks a changeable box 'I waive all rights' and prefills a changeable line 'Non-compete for 10 years applies' for Ada. Ada unticks the box, empties the line and signs: both fields are empty and the PDF does not carry the line. The sender then PUTs the envelope with the original values (an editor opened before Ada signed sends exactly this): 200, no code, Ada stays 'completed', both fields hold '1' and the sentence again, the PDF prints the sentence, and no 'Envelope corrected' line is written at all. Cause: writeContent only keeps a signer's value when old.value is not null, so an answer of 'empty' is not seen as an answer, and printedView compares prefill only. Route 2 (p1-seen.ts D and E): a full_name field of a copy recipient or of unfinished Ben sits above Ada's signature. After Ada signed, PUT with the copy recipient renamed to 'The price is changed to 1 dollar' is 200 without resign, and POST /envelopes/:id/correct renaming Ben to 'Ada pays a penalty of 9000 dollars' is 200. Ada stays 'completed' and is told nothing, and the final PDF pages carry the sentence.
checks.suggested_fix: In writeContent never write to a field whose owner has finished (keep old.value and old.prefill for doneIds), and record that a signer touched a field (store '' instead of NULL, or an answered flag) so an emptied field counts as answered. Put the values of finished people's fields, and the names and addresses printed by full_name and email fields, into printedView. Make correctRecipient apply the same rule (refuse, or a resign choice) when the renamed person has a full_name or email field and someone has finished.

checks.item: 2c. Signing again never uses or holds a second signature

Public form visitor asked again: '2 left, 0 held' throughout, one line. Bulk row through an API key: unchanged. In-person signer asked again: '2 left, 1 held' before and after (the hold is for the other signer), one line, so the fixer's note that an in-person signer is held again is no longer true after the later payment change. Replacing a finished signer with a different person (resign) holds one and uses one when the new person signs (ledger: ada, zed), and is refused with 402 when none is available, which matches the stated rule. You are asked before anything is saved.' After 'Replace file' and 'Save changes' the dialog reads 'Ada Sponsor already signed. Saving this means Ada Sponsor has to sign again. checks.item: 3a. The server refuses a save or a Finish from an older content version
checks.evidence: p3-version.ts A, B, C, E, F. Re-ran the auditor's c3 (file swapped and field moved while Ada had the page): Finish with the old version 409 code 'changed', Finish with no version 409, save with the old version 409, save with none 409. Consent from a stale page answers the new version but does not move seen_version, and a Finish afterwards is still 409. An approver and a viewer with a stale page are refused too and get 'Updated: ...'. Six runs of a correction and a Finish in the same moment: always exactly one wins, never a completed signer together with the new note. Left open and acceptable: a caller that sends no version is held to the last one the server gave that link, so a second tab or a preview that loads the link lets a version-less Finish through (C); a caller that never loaded the document at all can finish (G). The real page always sends its version.

checks.item: 3b. After the refusal the signing page shows the changed document before the person can finish
checks.evidence: ui1-swap.cjs and ui2-swap-finish.cjs, screenshots ui1-desktop-2-banner.png, ui1-phone-2-banner.png, ui2-2-review.png. The page reloads the data but not the PDF.
checks.still_broken: Signer opens the link, agrees, sees 'ORIGINAL CONTRACT, The price is 100 dollars'. The sender replaces the file of the same document ('Replace file' in the editor keeps the document id; here PUT with a new file_id) with 'SWAPPED CONTRACT, The price is 999999 dollars': 200. The signer adopts a signature; autosave gets 409 and the banner 'Demo Sender changed this document while you had it open ... Look at the document again before you finish' appears. The page under the banner still shows ORIGINAL CONTRACT at both 1280x900 and 390x844, and no request to /api/sign/:token/doc/... is made after the swap (0 fetches). The signer clicks 'I have looked', Finish, 'Finish and send': 'All done', envelope completed, signed file is the swapped one, 0 PDF fetches between swap and finish. Cause: PdfDoc and the Text view load by URL, the URL is /doc/<document id>, and load() changes neither the URL nor the key. Switching to Text view and back happens to fetch the new file, which is how I noticed the difference.
checks.suggested_fix: Return the file fingerprint (or the content version) per document from GET /sign/:token and put it in the PdfDoc and DocText url and key, for example /doc/<id>?v=<version>, so a new version remounts and fetches again. Keep Finish disabled until the new pages have rendered.

checks.evidence: p4-audit-inherit.ts 4A, 4B and p2-lock.ts. The same body sent again writes no second line. Quick Correct writes old and new address and that the old link stopped and answers were cleared. The lines are in the certificate text and the chain verifies. Gaps: a change that is not seen at all leaves no line (the restored answers in 2b), the hand-over line does not say the first person's answers were cleared, and the fingerprints break the phone layout (see screens).

checks.evidence: p8-order-api-alert.ts 9 and 8C. The two named cases are fixed; the same class of silent 200 remains in several places, while the API description now says 'Nothing in it is ignored without a word'.

A finished person's access_code or note changed in a correction: nothing is stored (stored value stays null). checks.item: 2b. Hand-over takes bulk batches along and writes an audit line on every handed-over envelope
checks.evidence: For a batch that has finished it holds: batch sender_id moves, successor opens and reminds it, each envelope has "Handed over: From X <x> to Y <y>: X was removed from the team" with the admin as actor, chain still verifies (fixer's test and p1-teams.ts 2.S4). Bea starts POST /bulk with 40 rows; after 3 rows have gone out the owner calls DELETE /account/members/<Bea>?to=<Sam> (200, handed_over 5). The bulk call carries on and answers 200 sent 40. Result: 36 of the 40 envelopes have sender_id = Bea, who is no longer in the account; only 4 belong to Sam. new_bugs.title: Deleting one account wipes other customers' stored emails, and makes their next renewal look unreminded
new_bugs.where: /home/user/treegens-app/sign-and-grow/src/server/routes-trust.ts, purgeUser(): the two DELETE FROM emails statements that match on esc(user.name) and on the address anywhere in the html
new_bugs.detail: Steps (tests/out/verify2-lifecycle/p3-closing.ts, section 3): a paying customer Vic has 8 stored emails that belong to no envelope (confirmation, welcome, receipt, "Heads up: your plan renews on ...", an invitation he sent, a password reset, a help request and its acknowledgement). A stranger signs up under the name "Sent with" (two words, so the name rule applies; every email of ours ends "Sent with Sign&Grow") and calls POST /me/delete {now:true}. Result: all 8 of the other people's copies are gone (0 left). Vic's next renewal then files the operator alert "Vic's workspace was renewed without a reminder reaching them first", because routes-billing.ts counts a reminder only when its email row exists. Everyday version: two customers called John Smith; when one deletes his account the stored copy of the invitation the other John Smith sent disappears (3.Y1, 3.Y2). The address match is a substring match as well, so deleting joe@example.com also matches billy.joe@example.com wherever that is printed. Nothing that is still waiting to be sent is touched, so no email is lost in transit; what is lost is the 90-day record of what was sent to other customers, plus false alerts for the operators. Suggested fix: never match on the name. Record on each emails row who it is about (user id or account id) when it is written and delete by that; until then match the address only as a whole (to_email equal, or "<address>" in brackets, or bounded by non-address characters).

new_bugs.title: 'Fix my name' keeps a free own-signature free under another person's name
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts renameSelf (free is never looked at again)
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p1-name.ts section J, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY set): Maria Garcia, maria@example.com, sends a document to herself under her own name. recipients.free is 1, balance 3. Open the signing link, agree, POST /sign/:token/name {name:'Pedro Garcia'}: answer {applied:true}. Finish. Result: free is still 1, the balance is still 3 and there is no 'signature' line in credits, so Pedro Garcia signed at the sender's address for nothing. The same change made by the sender with Correct sets free to 0 (J2). The rule is: free only under the sender's own name and address. Fix: in renameSelf, when the recipient is free and the new name is no longer the sender's own (isSelf is false), either do not apply it and ask the sender, or do what takeOverCost does: check the balance and set free=0.

new_bugs.title: A stored signature and typed answers stay on the request when its name is changed to another person at the same address
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts correctRecipient (same-inbox branch) and renameSelf; src/components/sign/fields.ts restoreMarks
new_bugs.detail: Full steps and result are in the check '1, new angle'. In short: Alex signs a field (autosaved), the sender corrects the name to Blair Rivera at the same address, Blair opens the same link and finds 'Your signature: Alex Rivera' already on her field, with Alex's typed answers, and can finish (200). Fix as given there: clear marks and consent when the name changes to something that is not a spelling of the old one.

new_bugs.title: 'Fix my name' accepts look-alike and one-letter-off versions of another recipient's name, and added titles
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts renameSelf (the `taken` check compares exact words only)
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p1-name.ts section B): envelope with Alex Rivera and Blair Rivera. On Alex's link POST /sign/:token/name with each of: 'Blaire Rivera', 'Blai Rivera', 'Bliar Rivera', 'Blaır Rivera' (dotless i), 'Вlair Rivera' (Cyrillic first letter), 'B. Rivera', 'Rivera'. Result: all applied; the envelope then lists for example 'Вlair Rivera' and 'Blair Rivera', which read the same on screen and on the certificate. Also applied (p6-odd.ts): 'Sam Signer, President of the United States', 'Sam Signer (on behalf of Blair Rivera, CEO)', and a name ending in the direction mark U+202E. The sender is told each time. A refused request can be repeated 5 times an hour per recipient and each one emails the sender whatever their settings (5 emails in section G). Fix: compare with other recipients using sameWord (one letter off) after folding look-alike letters, refuse a word that mixes scripts, strip control and direction characters, treat added words that are not in the sender's wording as a question for the sender, and send the question once per distinct name.

new_bugs.title: 'Find my documents' skips the newest document when one arrives between two asks, and says the list is complete
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts emailMyLinks (the place is an offset kept in memory per address)
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p3-find-copy.ts 6c2): 60 documents for nora@example.com. Ask once: the email lists New 060 down to New 011 ('numbers 1 to 50 of 60'). The sender sends document 61. Ask again within a day. Result: the second email says 'These are numbers 51 to 61 of 61, newest first' and 'That was the last of them', lists New 011 a second time down to New 001, and New 061, the one just sent and waiting for a signature, is in neither email. Only a third ask shows it. Anyone who types the address also moves the place. Fix: remember the (updated_at, id) of the last line sent and continue after it, and put anything newer than the first line of the previous email at the top; or send all parts at once as several emails.

new_bugs.title: A refused request or reminder is delivered after the person has already signed
new_bugs.where: src/server/mail.ts tooLate()
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p4-mail.ts B and C, mail server refusing): (B) send; the request fails; the sender copies the signing link and passes it on; the person signs and the envelope completes; the mail server comes back; the timer runs. Result: the signer now gets '<sender> sent you a document to sign' with the button 'Review and sign', and the audit trail gets 'Email sent' after 'Envelope completed'. (C) A reminder is refused, Ada signs, the timer runs: Ada gets 'Reminder: ...' after signing. Fix: mark emails that ask someone to act in the payload and drop them quietly in tooLate() when that recipient is completed or declined.

new_bugs.title: A withdrawn or replaced team invitation is still delivered later, with a link that no longer works
new_bugs.where: src/server/mail.ts tooLate(); src/server/routes-account.ts POST /account/invites (no expiresAt, no validity check)
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p4b-invite.ts): mail server refuses; POST /account/invites {email}; DELETE /account/invites/:id; mail server back; run the timer. Result: '<name> invited you to ...' is handed to the mail server, and its invite token is no longer in the invites table. The same happens to the first email when an invitation is sent a second time (the old token is deleted). Fix: in tooLate(), for a link with ?invite=, drop the email quietly unless that token is still an open invitation.

new_bugs.title: An access code frozen after the envelope was closed can never be reset, so the signer's copy is lost and the screen tells them to ask for something the sender cannot do
new_bugs.where: src/server/routes-sign.ts POST /sign/:token/unlock and ask-code; src/server/envelopes.ts correctRecipient, requestAccessCode
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p7-frozen-copy.ts): Ada (access code 123456) signs; the sender voids the envelope; ten wrong codes are typed on her link from any device (401 nine times, then 423). The right code from a new browser: 423 'This access code was entered wrongly 10 times, so it is frozen ... Jo Sender has been told and can set a new code. Ask them for the new one.' Download: 401. The sender tries POST /envelopes/:id/correct {recipient_id, access_code:'654321'}: 400 'Only envelopes that are out for signature can be corrected.' 'Ask the sender' on the frozen screen: 400 'This document is not waiting for an access code.' Result: the copy promised after closing cannot be reached again from any new browser. Fix: once an envelope is closed keep only the per-device wait and do not count towards the freeze, or allow a new access code and ask-code on a closed envelope for recipients who keep a copy.

new_bugs.title: A damaged PDF answers 500 'Something went wrong on our side' to a signer who attaches it (and to a sender who uploads it)
new_bugs.where: src/server/pdf.ts inspectPdf (doc.getPages() is outside the try); was the same before this batch
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p6-odd.ts): POST /sign/:token/upload with a file that starts with %PDF and is cut short ('%PDF-1.4 this is not really a pdf'). Result: 500 'Something went wrong on our side. Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell us this reference: req_...', and the signing screen adds 'Choose the file again, or try a PDF, PNG or JPEG.' A file of just '%PDF' gets the proper 400 'That file could not be read as a PDF.' Fix: put getPages() and the size reading inside the same try and answer 400 with that sentence.

new_bugs.title: When the sender's own request email is refused, the record says nothing at all about it
new_bugs.where: src/server/envelopes.ts advance() and the onMailOutcome listener
new_bugs.detail: Steps (p4-mail.ts K): the sender signs their own document, the mail server refuses the email. Result: the audit trail holds only 'Envelope sent': neither 'Sent to recipient' nor 'Email could not be sent yet', because advance() writes nothing for a refused email and the listener skips emails to the sender's own address. Fix: let the listener write the audit lines for any recipient email and only skip the extra notice to the sender, or write the line in advance().
